title: geum tanzybeicum
intro: Geum tanzybeicum, commonly known as Tanacetum geum, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum geum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
